field.label: Enable
field.help: Keep the "Home networks" list of Intrusion Detection up to date with the addresses your provider gives this firewall. Your own entries in that list are never changed. Turning this off stops further updates, the entries that were already added stay in the list until you remove them.

field.label: Interface
field.help: The interface that receives the delegated IPv6 prefix (DHCPv6 prefix delegation) and whose IPv4 address can be followed. Usually WAN.

field.label: Follow the IPv6 prefix
field.help: Keep the IPv6 prefix that your provider delegates to this firewall in the Home networks list, and replace it when the prefix changes. Recommended: without it your IPv6 devices are no longer recognised as yours when the provider changes the prefix.

field.label: Follow the IPv4 address
field.help: Keep the current IPv4 address of this interface (a single address) in the Home networks list, and replace it when your provider changes it. This covers the address of the firewall itself, which usually changes. For the best security also read the recommended setup on the Information tab.
